premises.text: Home air vents are outdated and inefficient for modern HVAC systems
premises.evidence_span: these were designed over 60 years ago based on the type of construction materials and insulation available at the time

premises.text: The average U.S. household spends a significant portion of their energy bill on heating or cooling
premises.evidence_span: the average U.S. household spends 50% of their home energy bill on heating or cooling, or about $2,000 per year

premises.text: Many rooms in homes are overheated or overcooled at various times
premises.evidence_span: the same household has an average of two to four rooms that are overheated or overcooled at various times

premises.text: A product can intelligently redirect airflow in homes with central HVAC systems
premises.evidence_span: provide a product, yes, a product, to people with central HVAC systems that can intelligently redirect airflow throughout their home

premises.text: The Keen Vent can maximize comfort and efficiency of HVAC systems
premises.evidence_span: The Keen Vent is a wirelessly networked home air vent. It maximizes the comfort and efficiency of a home's central heating or cooling system

premises.text: Keen Vents can be easily installed by users
premises.evidence_span: The user simply removes the existing vent from the duct opening and inserts the Keen Vent in its place

premises.text: A Lifestyle Survey can help automate vent programming for users
premises.evidence_span: customers will complete this short questionnaire with details about their home and habits when they initially set up their user account

premises.text: The Keen Vent system can reduce HVAC runtimes significantly
premises.evidence_span: the Keen Vent system of four vents reduces HVAC runtimes by up to 30%

premises.text: Partnerships with e-commerce and traditional retail will help sell the Keen Vent
premises.evidence_span: we will leverage e-commerce partnerships to sell the Keen Vent directly to consumers via the web

premises.text: Utility companies are interested in energy efficiency products
premises.evidence_span: utility companies are looking for energy efficiency products that help them with their peak load management initiatives

premises.text: The Keen Vent system can yield significant annual savings for customers
premises.evidence_span: using a four-Keen Vent system will yield average annual savings for our customers of $150 to $300

value.text: Customers can achieve improved comfort and energy efficiency in their homes
value.evidence_span: maximizes the comfort and efficiency of a home's central heating or cooling system

notes: Pre-orders and crowdfunding details excluded as traction.
